user.title: Trafiklab
user.description: API key for Trafiklab Realtime APIs (Bronze is enough).

reauth_confirm.title: Update API key
reauth_confirm.description: Trafiklab rejected the API key. Enter a new one.

reconfigure.title: Trafiklab keys
reconfigure.description: Key for Trafiklab Realtime APIs (departures) and, optionally, GTFS Regional Realtime (bus positions for the map).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Bussar is already set up. Add more lines on the integration instead.
abort.reauth_successful: The API key has been updated.

line.title: Choose line and platform
line.description: Each direction has its own platform. The list shows upcoming departures with their destinations.

manual.title: Enter line and platform
manual.description: Enter line and platform yourself, e.g. for a line with no departures in the next hour.

reconfigure.title: Walking times
reconfigure.description: Minutes from your door to the stop. The window is how long the gauge shows 'time to go'.

error.run_longer_than_walk: Running time cannot be longer than walking time.

abort.already_configured: That line and platform is already watched.

positions_quota_reached.title: Monthly limit for bus positions reached
positions_quota_reached.description: Bussar has made {limit} requests for bus positions this month and stops fetching them until the 1st of next month, so the Trafiklab key is not blocked. Departures and the gauges keep working.
